motivation: The frozen target-minus-placebo analysis found Gamma=0.019920, while the later control audit found neutral-placebo accuracy 0.012868 below baseline. This post-hoc sensitivity asks whether the diagonal selectivity estimate survives when each targeted scaffold is compared directly with the no-scaffold baseline, and separates global placebo harm from grouping-differential placebo effects.

estimands.target_minus_baseline_diagonal: For each of five targeted scaffolds, pair its frozen primary accuracy with baseline accuracy on the identical model, paradigm, difficulty, and item. Average items within each model-by-scaffold-by-paradigm cell; compute matched-grouping minus unmatched-grouping paradigm means; average models and then the five scaffold-specific contrasts. This is the frozen Gamma weighting with baseline replacing neutral placebo.
estimands.placebo_reference_identity: At every paired observation, target-minus-placebo equals target-minus-baseline plus baseline-minus-placebo. By linearity, Gamma_target-placebo = Gamma_target-baseline + Gamma_baseline-placebo. Report the exact pointwise reconstruction error, both global mean and diagonal-selectivity decompositions, and the placebo-reference share only as a descriptive ratio.
estimands.family_item_uncertainty: Use the frozen crossed family-by-item bootstrap: resample six model families with replacement while retaining both checkpoints, and independently resample 18 items within each of the 13 fixed paradigms. Apply identical draws jointly to target-minus-placebo, target-minus-baseline, and the duplicated placebo-minus-baseline contrast.
estimands.exact_mapping: Enumerate all 5! mappings of targeted scaffolds to theoretical groupings for the target-minus-baseline matrix, using the frozen inclusive tie and null-centered two-sided rules.
estimands.small_g_family: Average the two checkpoints in each of six families; report all family effects, leave-one-family-out values, an exact binomial sign test, and an exact 2^6 family sign-flip test.

bootstrap.reason_for_seed: Reuse the frozen primary family-by-item bootstrap seed so the jointly replayed target-minus-placebo interval must reproduce the authoritative interval exactly.

interpretation_constraints: Every result is a post-hoc sensitivity regardless of p-values or interval endpoints; it cannot revise the frozen nine-gate FAIL decision.
The target-minus-baseline contrast is not a new randomized arm and uses no new inference, rescoring, prompt, item, model, or threshold.

Baseline comparison removes dependence on the neutral-placebo score, but it can combine scaffold content, prompt length, and generic instruction effects; it does not by itself identify a cognitive mechanism.
The overall neutral-placebo accuracy decrement is not the placebo contribution to diagonal selectivity. Only grouping-differential placebo-minus-baseline effects enter Gamma.
The placebo-reference share divides by an estimated target-minus-placebo Gamma and can be unstable; absolute point estimates and bootstrap intervals take priority.
The fixed-paradigm family-by-item interval does not generalize to a population of paradigms.
With six families, exact family tests have coarse resolution and require sign symmetry or sign-exchangeability assumptions.
No output may include response text, stimuli, gold answers, item identifiers, or per-item scores.
